description: This file defines an adapter class for integrating Anthropic's language model API with a system called Pipecat. It includes methods for converting messages between standard, system, and Anthropic-specific formats, handling system prompts, tool calls, message merging, and logging sanitization. It also provides functions to convert function schemas into Anthropic's format for function calling features.

classes.name: AnthropicLLMInvocationParams
classes.description: TypedDict defining parameters for invoking Anthropic's LLM API, including system prompt, messages, and tools.

classes.name: AnthropicLLMAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class that converts system schemas and messages into the specific format required by Anthropic's Claude models, handling message conversion, system prompts, tool calls, logging, and cache markers.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns a string identifier used for messages specific to Anthropic within the system.

methods.name: AnthropicLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params( self, context: LLMContext, enable_prompt_caching: bool )
methods.description: Generates invocation parameters for Anthropic's LLM based on a universal context, including message formatting and optional prompt caching.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Produces a sanitized list of messages suitable for safe logging, removing or truncating sensitive or large data like images.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of universal context messages into Anthropic's message format, extracting system messages and consolidating consecutive messages with the same role.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_universal_context_message(self, message: LLMContextMessage)
methods.description: Converts individual universal context messages into Anthropic message format, handling special thought messages and standard messages.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_anthropic_specific_message(self, message: LLMSpecificMessage)
methods.description: Converts specific system or thought messages into Anthropic-compatible message format, handling signatures and special message types.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_standard_message(self, message: LLMStandardMessage)
methods.description: Converts a standard universal message into Anthropic format, handling tool calls, images, and empty content.

methods.name: List[MessageParam] _with_cache_control_markers(self, messages: List[MessageParam])
methods.description: Adds cache control markers to recent messages to integrate with prompt caching behavior in Anthropic.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_anthropic_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Converts a function schema into Anthropic's function format for API call definition.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Converts a set of tool schemas into a list of formatted definitions suitable for Anthropic's API.
